Coverage_Description: Dental care plan with appointment-based services, including dental cleaning; cleaning slots are limited and handled first-come-first-served
customer requirement: For HKU staff; family members can also join (no limit on number)
price structure: One-time full annual fee; no full or pro-rata refund
additional informations: Membership term is fixed from 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31; application processing takes about 10 working days, and booking should be made after SMS activation confirmation
